name: biokyn
description: BioKyn — self-hosted, privacy-preserving bot mitigation (Argon2id PoW, RFC 9497 VOPRF, WebAuthn)

scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace=@biokyn/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@biokyn/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@biokyn/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@biokyn/server
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@biokyn/client && npm run build --workspace=@biokyn/core && npm run build --workspace=@biokyn/server && npm run build --workspace=@biokyn/shim
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:packages
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspace=@biokyn/protocol && npm run test --workspace=@biokyn/core && npm run test --workspace=@biokyn/client && npm run test --workspace=@biokyn/server && npm run test:scripts
scripts.check: npm run check:lockfile && npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run test && npm run build:packages
scripts.test:vectors: node scripts/with-env.mjs REQUIRE_OFFICIAL_VECTORS=1 -- npm run test --workspace=@biokyn/protocol -- rfc9497.official
